SELECT u.id, u.username, u.real_name, u.phone, u.credit_score, u.credit_level, r.rule_name AS level_label, r.color AS level_color, (SELECT b.list_type FROM credit_blacklist b WHERE b.user_id = u.id AND b.status = 'ACTIVE' AND b.deleted = 0 AND (b.expire_time IS NULL OR b.expire_time > NOW()) ORDER BY FIELD(b.list_type, 'BLACKLIST', 'OVERRIDE', 'WARNING') LIMIT 1) AS risk_type, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lease_order o WHERE o.user_id = u.id AND o.deleted = 0 AND o.status = 'COMPLETED') AS finished_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lease_order o WHERE o.user_id = u.id AND o.deleted = 0 AND o.status = 'CANCELLED' AND o.pay_time IS NOT NULL) AS cancel_count, u.create_time FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN credit_rule r ON r.rule_type = 'LEVEL' AND r.rule_code = u.credit_level AND r.deleted = 0 WHERE u.deleted = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role ro ON ro.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = u.id AND ro.role_code = 'USER')
AND (u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND u.credit_level = #{level}
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM credit_blacklist b WHERE b.user_id = u.id AND b.status = 'ACTIVE' AND b.deleted = 0 AND (b.expire_time IS NULL OR b.expire_time > NOW()))
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM credit_blacklist b WHERE b.user_id = u.id AND b.list_type = #{riskType} AND b.status = 'ACTIVE' AND b.deleted = 0 AND (b.expire_time IS NULL OR b.expire_time > NOW()))
ORDER BY u.credit_score ASC, u.id ASC
